args.message:
Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

round_money() documented banker's rounding but used ROUND_HALF_UP,
causing tests/test_money.py to fail (2.675 rounded to 2.68 in both
directions instead of 2.665 -> 2.66). Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to
match FIN-212.

args.head: fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
`round_money()` in `src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`, which asserts banker's rounding behavior (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Change
- Import and apply `decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `round_money()`.

## Testing
- CI on this branch passed (all tests green, including `test_half_even`).

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Root cause:** `src/money.py`'s `round_money()` docstring claimed banker's rounding per FIN-212, but the code used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, so `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`, failing `tests/test_money.py` in the nightly build.
- **Fix:** On branch `fin-212-bankers-rounding`, switched to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money()` (commit `08d3cd5`).
- **CI:** Triggered a run on the branch — it passed (run `ci-0001`).
- **PR:** Opened #101 against `main` ("Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212") with alex requested as reviewer: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

No merge was performed, per policy — it awaits alex/code-owner review.
